title: Booking Confirmation – ThePaymaster®
heading: Booking Confirmation
body:
Success

Thank You For Booking Your Call

You’ll receive a confirmation email with your scheduled call details shortly.

Next Steps for SENDERS

To help us prepare for our discussion, we invite you to begin our secure onboarding process. You’ll need to provide:

  • Company details
  • Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) information
  • Corporate banking details
  • Source of Funds supporting information and declaration
  • Your passport for identity verification

You can complete this process now or later:

To use the QR code, open your phone’s camera and point it at the code above. Click the link that appears to begin the onboarding process.

Or click here to start Onboarding from your desktop https://in.sumsub.com/websdk/p/uni_22pfv3pkXEDmwJZL

This link will also be in your confirmation email for easy access later.

Recipients and Authorised Third Parties

We’ll discuss your specific next steps during our scheduled call.

Have questions? We’re here to help:

• Phone: +44 20 7088 8267
